CHN.note: USDA PSD 2024 (carcass-weight equiv): prod ~57.0 Mt / cons ~58.2 Mt / imports ~1.45 Mt — the lowest since 2019. Import bill collapsed ~40% y/y as the herd rebuilt after African Swine Fever.

EU.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe) EU-27 bloc node: prod ~21.2 Mt / cons ~18.6 Mt / exports ~4.25 Mt to third countries. Collectively the world's largest pork exporter; Spain/Germany/Netherlands/Denmark lead. Intra-EU trade excluded.

USA.note: USDA PSD/USMEF 2024: prod ~12.7 Mt cwe; record exports 3.03 Mt worth US$8.63bn. #1 single-country exporter by value; Mexico, Japan, China/HK, Korea, Colombia top destinations.

DEU.note: Germany 2024 (USDA/Destatis): prod ~4.9 Mt; large EU producer and net exporter, mainly intra-EU plus third-country. Herd shrank since the 2020 ASF case shut China access.

ESP.note: Spain 2024: prod ~5.0 Mt; the EU's top pork exporter and #2 globally by value (US$6.3bn). Heavy exposure to China, Japan, Philippines and intra-EU.

BRA.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~5.3 Mt; exports ~1.53 Mt, #3-4 global exporter. China, Philippines, Hong Kong, Chile, Japan lead markets.

CAN.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~2.25 Mt; exports ~1.5 Mt. #4 global exporter; USA, Japan, Mexico, China top destinations.

DNK.note: Denmark 2024: prod ~1.5 Mt; one of the most export-dependent pork sectors (Danish Crown). Ships to the EU, UK, Japan, China; #6 exporter by value.

NLD.note: Netherlands 2024: large transit/processing hub; exports ~1.9 Mt (incl. re-export) against high imports. Supplies Germany, Italy, China, UK.

MEX.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~1.6 Mt; cons ~2.9 Mt. World's #2-3 importer (US$3.25bn, +18% y/y) and the largest single buyer of US pork.

JPN.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~1.3 Mt; imports ~1.28 Mt — the world's #1 pork importer by value (US$4.27bn). Supplied by USA, Canada, Spain, Mexico, Denmark.

KOR.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~1.32 Mt; imports ~0.6 Mt. #5 importer by value; USA, EU (Spain/Netherlands/Germany), Canada, Chile supply.

PHL.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~0.95 Mt (suppressed by ASF); imports ~0.6 Mt and rising. Spain, Brazil, USA, Canada lead suppliers.

VNM.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~3.8 Mt — a top-5 producer/consumer largely self-sufficient. HS-0203 imports ~0.2 Mt; import value fell ~29% y/y as domestic supply recovered from ASF.

GBR.note: UK 2024: prod ~0.95 Mt; net importer (US$1.22bn). Heavily dependent on EU supply — Denmark, Germany, Netherlands, Spain, Ireland — for bacon/processed pork.

ITA.note: Italy 2024: prod ~1.35 Mt; #3 importer by value (US$3.18bn), buying from Germany, Spain, Netherlands, Denmark, France to feed its cured-ham industry.

RUS.note: USDA PSD 2024 (cwe): prod ~4.9 Mt; roughly self-sufficient and a small net exporter to Vietnam, Belarus and (newly) China. HS-0203 imports negligible.

AUS.note: Australia 2024: prod ~0.47 Mt; net importer of frozen processing pork (US$0.6bn, +24% y/y) from USA, Denmark, Netherlands, Canada; fresh pork restricted on biosecurity grounds.

COL.note: Colombia 2024: prod ~0.54 Mt; fast-growing importer (US$0.45bn, +31% y/y) supplied overwhelmingly by the USA.

ITC Trade Map 2024: Japan imported ~175 kt of pork from Spain (HS 0203); Spain is Japan's #3 supplier by value.

ITC 2024: Denmark supplied ~70 kt to Japan (US$0.27bn); volume from value at Japan's average HS-0203 unit price.

ITC 2024: Brazil's pork to Mexico rose +70% to US$0.11bn; ~43 kt at Mexico's average HS-0203 unit value.

ITC 2024: Spain supplied Italy US$0.74bn of pork; ~280 kt at Italy's HS-0203 unit value — feeds prosciutto production.

ITC 2024: Denmark to Italy US$0.31bn; ~120 kt at Italy's HS-0203 unit value.
ITC 2024: France to Italy US$0.24bn; ~90 kt at Italy's HS-0203 unit value.

ITC 2024: Germany supplies the UK processed-pork market; ~110 kt at the UK's HS-0203 unit value.
ITC 2024: Netherlands to UK ~105 kt at the UK's HS-0203 unit value; bacon and fresh cuts.
ITC 2024: Spain to UK ~95 kt at the UK's HS-0203 unit value.

rankings.note: Exporter ranks are USDA PSD 2024 export volumes (cwe); the EU-27 is shown as a bloc (extra-EU) and Spain/Germany/Denmark/Netherlands also appear as lead member shippers, so the EU line and member lines overlap by design. Importer ranks blend USDA PSD (cwe) with ITC/Comtrade 2024 HS-0203 figures. China's import is shown at its current depressed ~1.45 Mt level (down ~40% y/y post-ASF). Balances are carcass-weight equivalent; flows are HS-0203 product weight (different bases).

companies.name: WH Group / Smithfield Foods
companies.metric: Revenue ~US$26bn (2024); world's largest pork company, processing 30+ mn hogs/yr across China, the US (Smithfield) and Europe.
companies.note: Hong Kong-listed WH Group owns Smithfield (America's largest pork producer) plus major Chinese (Shuanghui) and European operations. Vertically integrated from hog farms to packaged meats.
companies.improve: Should publish per-origin HS-0203 export tonnage so the share of China's domestic supply and US export base inside one firm is visible.

companies.name: JBS S.A.
companies.metric: Group revenue ~US$77bn (2024); pork via Seara (Brazil) and JBS USA (Swift), among the top global pork processors.
companies.note: World's largest meat company; pork arm spans Brazil and the US, a major exporter to China, Japan, Mexico, the Philippines.
companies.improve: Should report standalone HS-0203 export tonnage by origin and destination.

companies.name: Danish Crown
companies.note: Farmer-owned cooperative; among the world's biggest pork exporters, shipping to the EU, UK, Japan, China. Anchors Denmark's outsized pork trade surplus.
companies.improve: Should publish audited per-market HS-0203 tonnage.

companies.name: Tonnies
companies.metric: Revenue ~EUR 8bn (2024); Germany's largest pork slaughterer, ~16-20 mn hogs/yr.
companies.note: Privately held; dominant in German and EU pork slaughter and a major intra-EU and third-country exporter. Lost direct China access after Germany's 2020 ASF case.
companies.improve: Private; per-destination export tonnage would let analysts size its EU-market concentration.

companies.name: BRF S.A.
companies.metric: Revenue ~US$11bn (2024); major Brazilian pork and poultry processor/exporter (Sadia, Perdigao).
companies.note: Leading Brazilian exporter of pork and poultry to the Middle East, Asia and the Americas; under the Marfrig/MBRF umbrella.
companies.improve: Should separate HS-0203 pork export volume by destination from poultry.

companies.name: Vion Food Group
companies.metric: Revenue ~EUR 5bn (2024); major Dutch-German pork and beef processor.
companies.note: Processes pork in the Netherlands and Germany for EU retail, foodservice and export; central to the Dutch processing/transit hub.
companies.improve: Should give per-market HS-0203 tonnage to clarify its role in EU pork flows.

global.note: World pork totals, kt carcass-weight equivalent, USDA PSD. Production recovered strongly 2020-2023 as China's herd rebuilt from African Swine Fever, plateauing near ~115.5 Mt in 2024. Exports peaked ~2021 then eased to ~10.4 Mt as China's import demand fell to pre-ASF levels.

forecast.method: OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook envelope; 2030=2024×(1+rate)^6. Global pigmeat output projected to rise only modestly (~0.7%/yr) with growth concentrated in SE Asia and Latin America while China plateaus; pork trade grows slower than other meats.
